aml.title: Acute Myeloid Leukemia (M2 type)
aml.author: Makysm
aml.caption: AML blood film. The source identifies Auer rods in some cells; not every AML case has them. “M2” is the source’s historical classification.
aml.alt: Real AML blood film with numerous large purple immature cells, including cells with visible nucleoli, among red cells.
aml.modifications: Resized proportionally to 1400 × 1168 pixels and JPEG-compressed; no cropping or content alteration.

cll.title: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia
cll.author: Mary Ann Thompson / VashiDonsk at English Wikipedia
cll.caption: CLL peripheral blood smear, Wright stain. Source microscope magnification: 1000×; on-screen size varies.
cll.alt: Real CLL blood smear with several small round purple lymphocytes, little visible cytoplasm, and surrounding pink red blood cells.

all.title: Lymphoblasts in acute lymphoblastic leukemia
all.author: SpicyMilkBoy
all.caption: Lymphoblasts in peripheral blood from a patient with ALL. The source does not specify B- or T-lineage.
all.alt: Real ALL blood film showing several purple lymphoblasts with large nuclei and narrow rims of cytoplasm among red blood cells.

reactive.title: Reactive lymph
reactive.author: Bobjgalindo
reactive.caption: A reactive lymphocyte surrounded by red cells. The source does not identify a specific infection.
reactive.alt: Real blood smear with a single large reactive lymphocyte near the center, an irregular purple nucleus, and pale blue cytoplasm among many pink red cells.
